brief:
An Israeli drone strike on a group of civilians in Tuffah, eastern Gaza City, killed at least three people, Al Jazeera reported, citing a source at Al-Shifa Hospital. The strike targeted the densely populated residential area in the early hours of the operation.

The casualties were brought to Al-Shifa Hospital, Gaza's largest medical facility, where hospital staff confirmed the deaths to international media.
dek: Israeli drone strike on Gaza kills three Israeli drone strike targeted a group of civilians in Tuffah in eastern Gaza City, killing at least three people, Al Jazeera reported, citing a source at Al-Shifa Hospital.
title: Israeli drone strike kills three in Gaza City
